from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('app.js');s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if 'plan-week-summary' not in s:
    m=re.search(r"  function renderPlan\(\)\{.*?\n\n  function recipeGameAppearances",s,re.S)
    if not m: raise SystemExit('renderPlan block missing')
    n="""  function renderPlan(){const dates=weekDates(),todayKey=dateKey(new Date());$('#weekLabel').textContent=`${formatShortDate(dates[0])} – ${formatShortDate(dates[6])}`;$('#weekDays').innerHTML=dates.map(d=>`<div class=\"day-pill ${dateKey(d)===todayKey?'today':''}\"><b>${d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'short'})}</b><span>${d.getDate()}</span></div>`).join('');const planned=[];for(const d of dates){const key=dateKey(d),day=state.mealPlan[key]||{};for(const slot of activeMealSlots()){const item=day[slot],r=getRecipe(item?.recipeId);if(r)planned.push({key,d,slot,item,r})}}const summary=planned.length?`<section class=\"plan-week-summary\"><div class=\"plan-summary-head\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">This week</p><h3>Planned recipes</h3></div><small>${planned.length} meal${planned.length===1?'':'s'}</small></div><div class=\"plan-summary-list\">${planned.map(x=>`<button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-summary-recipe\" data-recipe-id=\"${x.r.id}\" data-recipe-serving=\"${Number(x.item.servings)||Number(x.r.servings)||2}\"><span>${foodEmoji(x.r)}</span><span><b>${esc(x.r.title)}</b><small>${esc(x.d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'short'}))} · ${esc(x.slot)} · ${Number(x.item.servings)||Number(x.r.servings)||2} servings</small></span><i>›</i></button>`).join('')}</div></section>`:'';const days=dates.map(d=>{const key=dateKey(d),day=state.mealPlan[key]||{};return `<article class=\"plan-day\"><div class=\"plan-day-head\"><b>${esc(formatLongDate(d))}</b><small>${key===todayKey?'Today':''}</small></div>${activeMealSlots().map(slot=>{const item=day[slot];if(item?.recipeId){const r=getRecipe(item.recipeId);if(r){const sv=Number(item.servings)||Number(r.servings)||2,sub=`${totalTime(r)} min · ${sv} servings${item.prepNote?` · ${item.prepNote}`:''}${item.extraPortions?` · +${item.extraPortions} leftover${item.extraPortions===1?'':'s'}`:''}`;return `<div class=\"plan-slot filled\"><span>${slot}</span><button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-slot-recipe\" data-recipe-id=\"${r.id}\" data-recipe-serving=\"${sv}\"><b>${esc(r.title)}</b><small>${esc(sub)}</small></button><button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-slot-edit\" data-meal-date=\"${key}\" data-meal-slot=\"${slot}\" aria-label=\"Edit ${esc(slot)}\">•••</button></div>`}}if(item?.custom)return `<div class=\"plan-slot filled\"><span>${slot}</span><button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-slot-recipe\" data-meal-date=\"${key}\" data-meal-slot=\"${slot}\"><b>${esc(item.custom)}</b><small>${esc(item.prepNote||'Custom meal')}</small></button><button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-slot-edit\" data-meal-date=\"${key}\" data-meal-slot=\"${slot}\" aria-label=\"Edit ${esc(slot)}\">•••</button></div>`;return `<button type=\"button\" class=\"plan-slot empty\" data-meal-date=\"${key}\" data-meal-slot=\"${slot}\"><span>${slot}</span><div><b>Add meal</b></div><i class=\"plan-add\">+</i></button>`}).join('')}</article>`}).join('');$('#mealPlanGrid').innerHTML=summary+days}

  function recipeGameAppearances"""
    s=s[:m.start()]+n+s[m.end():]
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
